name: Bermaz Auto Berhad
overview: 2026年，Bermaz Auto Berhad 的公告主要涉及股息派发、股东大会及季度业绩，未披露具体业务板块的扩张、新增、缩减或出售事项。
overview_en: In 2026, Bermaz Auto Berhad's announcements mainly covered dividend payments, general meetings, and quarterly results, with no specific disclosures on expansion, new business, reduction, or disposal of business segments.
